question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a zero of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-1,-4]\times [1,4]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}2{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-4 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-8\end{aligned}]. $$ Calculate the second iteration of the Newton-Raphson process that starts at ${x}_{0}=[-1,\,4]^{T}$ if the first iteration of the algorithm gives ${x}_{1}=[-2.5,\,2.5]^{T}.$
${x}_{2}=[$ {{field-1}} $]$
{{field-2}}
question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of finding the zeros of a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n}$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{J}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}f({x}_{n}),
$$

where ${J}_{f}({x}_{n})$ is the Jacobian of $f$ evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the Jacobian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{J}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-4) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-4) \\ \frac{∂}{∂x}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-8) & \frac{∂}{∂y}({x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-8)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4x & -2y \\ 2x & 2y\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}4x & -2y \\ 2x & 2y\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}2{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-4 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-8\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

For the second iteration, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={x}_{1}-{[\begin{aligned}4x & -2y \\ 2x & 2y\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}2{x}^{2}-{y}^{2}-4 \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2}-8\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{1}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2.5 \\ 2.5\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}4(-2.5) & -2(2.5) \\ 2(-2.5) & 2(2.5)\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}2(-2.5)^{2}-(2.5)^{2}-4 \\ (-2.5)^{2}+(2.5)^{2}-8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2.5 \\ 2.5\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}-10 & -5 \\ -5 & 5\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}2.25 \\ 4.5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2.5 \\ 2.5\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{(-10)\cdot 5-(-5)\cdot (-5)}[\begin{aligned}5 & 5 \\ 5 & -10\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2.25 \\ 4.5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2.5 \\ 2.5\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{75}[\begin{aligned}33.75 \\ -33.75\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2.05 \\ 2.05\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
